children: The operator of Ariane 6 heavy rockets said on Wednesday it had won contracts for 10 new launches for Europe's heavy launcher.
The contracts are due to be announced at an international gathering on space being held in Paris this week, Arianespace CEO David Cavailloles told the International Space Summit.
Ariane 6 currently has about 30 orders, a spokesperson said.
